(Translated by Google) Finally, some quality food! We had Tonkotsu ramen and sushi. I was skeptical at first, as it's uncommon in Japan for a restaurant to specialize in multiple dishes, such as both ramen and sushi; this usually indicates poor quality. I was shocked! The ramen was very tasty, the broth flavorful but not heavy. The nigiri had the right cut of fish and the right ratio of fish to rice. The rice finally had the right flavor (many restaurants in Europe use very little salt and very little rice vinegar). I was truly satisfied!

(Translated by Google) Located within the dynamic atmosphere of a shopping center in Edinburgh, Maki & Ramen greets you with a queue stretching for meters, requiring considerable patience. However, gastronomy enthusiasts know one thing well: places that live up to their waiting times offer a satisfying finale. Indeed, once we sat down and tasted our first bites, I can confidently say that every minute we waited was well worth it. The interior, blending the authentic texture of East Asia with modern elegance, transports you from Scotland to the mysterious and mystical streets of the Far East. When you add the team's practical, extremely efficient, friendly, and solution-oriented service to this captivating environment, the experience reaches a flawless rhythm. As for the flavors and cooking techniques, a perfect balance of mastery and consistency prevails on the plate. The main ingredient, the meaty ramen soup, was captivating with its deep and silky texture brought about by hours of slow-simmering bone broth. The meat inside, thanks to the marinade and the perfect cooking degree, was incredibly tender, melting in your mouth and falling apart into strands. On the sushi side, the freshness of the ingredients in the recipes and the ideal balance of vinegar and sugar in the rice were immediately noticeable. The Salmon Avocado Roll we experienced achieved a delicious harmony with the freshness of the salmon and the creamy texture of the avocado. The Salmon Panko Roll offered a wonderful textural contrast with its crispy panko coating being perfectly fried without absorbing oil; while the Steak Tataki, offered with a halal meat option, transformed into a flavor feast that broke the mold in sushi with the degree to which the outside of the meat was seared and the inside was juicy and tender. In short, if you want to embark on a Far Eastern culinary journey with deep ramen and fresh sushi varieties prepared with the right cooking techniques, even if you are willing to wait in line during your trip to Edinburgh, Maki & Ramen is definitely a stop not to be missed.

(Original)
Edinburgh’da bir alışveriş merkezinin dinamik atmosferi içinde yer alan Maki & Ramen, kapısında metrelerce uzayan ve ciddi sabır gerektiren bir kuyrukla sizi karşılıyor. Ancak gastronomi tutkunlarının iyi bildigi bir gerçek vardır ki, o da kapısındaki sıranın hakkını veren mekanların sunduğu o tatmin edici finaldir. Nitekim masaya oturup ilk lokmaları tattığımızda, beklediğimiz her dakikaya sonuna kadar değdiğini gönül rahatlığıyla söyleyebilirim.
Doğu Asya’nın otantik dokusunu modern bir zarafetle harmanlayan iç atmosferi, sizi adeta İskoçya’dan alıp Uzak Doğu’nun gizemli ve mistik sokaklarına götürüyor. Bu büyüleyici ortama, ekibin pratik, son derece seri, güler yüzlü ve çözüm odaklı hizmet anlayışı da eklenince deneyim kusursuz bir ritme kavuşuyor.
Mutfaktan çıkan lezzetlere ve pişirme tekniklerine gelince; tabağa tam anlamıyla bir ustalık ve kıvam dengesi hakim. Ana rolü üstlenen etli ramen çorbası, saatlerce ağır ağır demlenmiş kemik suyunun getirdiği derin ve ipeksi kıvamıyla büyüleyiciydi. İçindeki etler ise marinasyonun ve doğru pişirme derecesinin hakkını vererek lif lif ayrılan, ağızda adeta eriyen muazzam bir yumuşaklığa sahipti.
Sushi tarafında ise reçetelerdeki malzeme tazeliği ve pirincin sirke-şeker dengesindeki ideal kıvam hemen göze çarpıyordu. Deneyimlediğimiz Salmon Avocado Roll, somonun tazeliği ve avokadonun kremsi dokusuyla nefis bir uyum yakalamış. Salmon Panko Roll, dışındaki çıtır panko kaplamasının yağ çekmeden tam kıvamında kızartılmasıyla harika bir doku kontrastı sunarken; helal et seçeneğiyle sunulan Steak Tataki ise etin dış yüzeyinin mühürlenme derecesi ve içinin o sulu, yumuşak yapısıyla sushide ezber bozan bir lezzet şölenine dönüştü.
Özetle; Edinburgh seyahatinizde sıra beklemeyi göze alarak, doğru pişirme teknikleriyle hazırlanmış derinlikli bir ramen ve taptaze sushi çeşitleriyle Uzak Doğu lezzet yolculuğuna çıkmak istiyorsanız, Maki & Ramen kesinlikle kaçırılmaması gereken bir durak.

Hugely disappointed by this place. It's got great reviews from friends, but I cannot see for the life of me why that would be. The food is extraordinarily bland - I went with a friend who got their spiciest dish and it had no spice to it whatsoever. I got the chicken ramen, and when it first arrived, the chicken was raw. The server explained that the pink colour I was noticing was because it was marinated in pink gin before it was cooked, but that they'd be happy to replace it. My second serving had the same issue. While it wasn't pink, it had the texture of severely undercooked chicken and was translucent in some areas (I've attached a photo, though it was more visible in person). Another server explained that this was due to it being chicken thigh, which makes it more "succulent". I've eaten a lot of chicken thigh in my life and it has never had that texture when cooked. Safe to say I didn't eat anything further.

Every time a customer is seated, a staff member bangs a drum. This is weird, but amusing at first, but quickly becomes incredibly grating. The whole place is decorated like an overdone gimmick of Japan, making it feel more like a cheap Disney display than a comfortable place to eat. I was also disappointed to learn that the £5 ramen offer you get for downloading their app does not apply in this location for whatever reason.

The staff were an absolute delight, and did not charge me for my disastrous meal. They are attentive and friendly, and I can only assume the failures of this place are due to it being a poorly managed chain.
